description: Defines types, enums, and classes for representing GLSL shader variables, interface blocks, and related concepts within the ANGLE project. Includes shader variable structures, interface block management, and workgroup size handling.

classes.name: ShaderVariable
classes.description: Represents a shader variable (uniform, varying, etc.) with properties like type, name, array sizes, and layout info.

classes.name: InterfaceBlock
classes.description: Represents an interface block in GLSL, including its name, layout, and contained shader variables.

classes.name: WorkGroupSize
classes.description: Encapsulates the size of a compute shader workgroup, with methods to set and compare sizes.

methods.name: InterpolationTypesMatch
methods.description: Validates if two interpolation qualifiers are compatible.

methods.name: isWorkGroupSizeMatching
methods.description: Checks if two workgroup size declarations are equivalent.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills the workgroup size with a specified value.

methods.name: setLocalSize
methods.description: Sets the local size dimensions for a workgroup.
